load_when: When creating/modifying a domain, connector or business feature, or on R16/R17 coherence check.

rule_1_modular_residence.statement: Every business rule must reside within a unique, modular domain directory.

rule_2_async_inter_domain.statement: Inter-domain communication is strictly asynchronous via Event-Driven or Abstract Connectors.

rule_3_no_foreign_state.statement: Never allow a domain to access the database or memory of another domain directly.

layers.domain: entities, value-objects, domain-events, business-rules (pure, no infra)
layers.infrastructure: connectors only (DB, API, env access lives here)

bounded_context_template.owns_storage: [schema / table prefix owned exclusively by this domain]

connectors.principle: All infrastructure, APIs and databases are abstracted behind a Connector. The domain depends on the connector interface, never the concrete implementation.

connector_template.kind: [database / api / queue / cache / email / payment / storage]
connector_template.interface: [port name — typed contract consumed by the domain]

secure_key_broker.principle: Zero direct env access. No sub-agent or skill may invoke process.env or read raw config. Secrets injected at runtime via unified Secure Key Broker.
rules: Reading *.env or *.private.json from domain or application layers forbidden
Broker resolves and delivers typed secrets to connectors at runtime
Secrets are never logged, serialized or embedded in commits

broker_template.scope: [domain id that may request this key]

skills.principle: Domain capabilities exposed as Skills: atomic, typed, reusable functions. 1:1 mapping with domain Use Cases.

compatibility_contract: Maintain full compatibility with existing abstractions, classes and types in architect-ai-framework and architect-ai-modules. Create new domains by replicating the architect-ai-modules/templates skeleton.
